# /handoff-open - release your lane to the open list

Read `.claude/skills/swimlanes/HANDOFF.md` first. In short:

```bash
python3 Tools/Build/handoff.py open --note "<where it stands; the next step; what is untested>"
```

Add `--lane <key>` to name the lane. Commit `Docs/Handoffs/` and push (`docs(handoff): <lane> back to open`). The lane
opens on the board even while your branch is unmerged, with your note at the top of its work.
